_help: Programs the install would otherwise compile on every PC, built once by .github/workflows/prebuilt.yml from the source pinned here and published as a release. The workflow runs when this file changes and builds each entry that has no url yet; put the url and sha256 from its run summary here by hand, so an install never downloads something this file has not pinned. Bump rev to publish a new build of the same source. An entry without a url is built on the PC as before.
